cases.title: 2027 Bioinformatics Scientist Summer Intern
cases.rawText:
2027 Bioinformatics Scientist Summer Intern

Research & Development

Summer 2027 Internship
Join our biomedical data science team working on bioinformatics and drug-development data. You will use Python, R/Bioconductor and SQL on high-performance computing infrastructure.
- Applicants must be currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD program in bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related quantitative field.
- A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 is required.
- Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not provide visa sponsorship for internships.
- Hourly rate: $32.00 - $41.00 per hour depending on degree level.
- 12 weeks, May 2027 through August 2027, on-site in Columbus.
Application requires a resume and an unofficial transcript. Selected candidates complete a recorded video interview.

work_authorization.value: US work authorization required; no visa sponsorship

degree_fields.value: Bioinformatics, computational biology or related quantitative field

cases.title: Summer Intern, Process Development
cases.rawText:
Summer Intern, Process Development

Support upstream process development and cGMP tech transfer for biologics drug substance.

Requirements
- Master's students accepted.
- Must have completed at least one year of the graduate program before the start date.
- Must continue enrollment after the internship concludes.

Rolling review; no fixed deadline stated. 40 hours per week.

cases.title: Summer Internship Program in Biomedical Research
cases.rawText:
Summer Internship Program in Biomedical Research

Applicants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents and must be enrolled at least half-time in an accredited graduate or undergraduate program.

Research training in genomics, single-cell analysis and computational biology within the NIH Intramural Research Program.

Graduate students are eligible. Students must be 17 years of age or older.

Pay: 3800-5200 Per Month
